windows.changelog:
- BYB Cloud: your profiles, vehicles, setups and runs on every device
- Share runs, leverage curves and laps with your coach or other riders
- Ask BYB: ask the AI about your run
- Customizable setup sheet, leverage catalog, vehicles without suspension
- New maps: acceleration & braking, lean angle
- Firmware 4.1 support and faster download
- Now in Italian, Spanish, German, French and Portuguese
- Built-in user manual
- Various bug fixes and stability improvements
